title: How to complete PenCom RSA data recapture in Nigeria
summary: How existing RSA holders update pension biodata and identity records through their Pension Fund Administrator under PenCom's Data Recapture Exercise, including current NIN, identity and BVN requirements.
feeNote: Use your licensed PFA's official recapture route. Do not pay an unofficial agent to alter pension identity records.
timeline: Depends on the PFA's identity verification and PenCom/ECRS processing.
requirements: Your existing RSA PIN and the Pension Fund Administrator that manages the account.
NIMC enrolment slip or NIN card showing the NIN and date of birth.
A valid identity document accepted under PenCom's current recapture documentation rules.
BVN information, which PenCom made mandatory for RSA registration and data recapture.
Any additional record requested by your PFA only where it is needed to reconcile an inconsistency in the pension record.
steps: Contact the licensed PFA that holds your RSA and ask for its official Data Recapture Exercise route or service centre.
Provide the RSA PIN and complete the PFA's recapture form with your current biodata and contact information.
Present or upload the current NIN evidence, accepted identity document and BVN information required for the recapture.
Complete any biometric or signature capture required by the PFA and review the information before submission.
Keep the PFA acknowledgement and follow up until the PFA confirms that the recaptured data has been accepted on the pension registration system.
notes: Data recapture updates an existing RSA record; it is not a reason to open a second RSA.
PenCom's February 2026 circular simplified the documentation required from RSA holders for the exercise.
If you have multiple RSA PINs, use the multiple-RSA resolution guide because reconciliation is an additional process.

title: How to resolve uncredited pension contributions in Nigeria
summary: What to do when pension money has reached a PFA but cannot yet be credited to the correct employee RSA, including the documents PenCom asks employees with and without RSA PINs to provide.
feeNote: Use the responsible PFA and PenCom's official guidance. This is different from an employer that never remitted the contribution.
timeline: Resolution depends on identifying the employee, reconciling the remittance and crediting the correct RSA.
requirements: If you already have an RSA PIN: the valid RSA PIN and a copy of the PFA welcome letter where requested.
A copy of your employment letter so the affected employment can be matched to the remittance.
Completion of the Data Recapture Exercise if you have not already completed it.
If you do not yet have an RSA: open one with a licensed PFA before the uncredited contribution can be matched to your pension account.
steps: Confirm with the employer or PFA that the issue is an uncredited contribution rather than a contribution that was never remitted.
If you have an RSA, obtain the RSA PIN or welcome letter and confirm that your Data Recapture Exercise is complete.
Provide the employment letter and RSA evidence to the PFA where the uncredited contribution is being held, following PenCom's employee guidance.
If you do not have an RSA, open one with a PFA of your choice, then provide the new welcome letter to the PFA holding the uncredited contribution and to your employer for future remittances.
Follow up with the PFA until it confirms that the remittance has been identified and credited to the correct RSA.
notes: Uncredited contributions are different from unremitted contributions: money may already have been paid but lack enough information to reach the correct RSA.
Where the RSA is already with the PFA holding the uncredited contribution, PenCom says the employee may only need to provide the valid RSA PIN for review or confirmation.
Use the separate unremitted-contributions guide when the employer did not pay the pension contribution at all.

title: How to resolve multiple RSA PINs in Nigeria
summary: How an RSA holder with more than one pension PIN starts reconciliation so duplicate registrations can be resolved and contributions associated with the valid RSA record.
feeNote: Use your PFA and PenCom's official process. Do not create another RSA to fix duplicate PINs.
timeline: Depends on data recapture, PFA records and PenCom reconciliation of the duplicate accounts.
requirements: All RSA PINs or evidence of the multiple RSA registrations.
A valid RSA record that can be used for the reconciliation process.
A completed Data Recapture Exercise record for the RSA PIN your PFA identifies as the valid account for reconciliation.
Your full name, NIN, employer history and other identity information needed to match contributions attached to the duplicate RSA PINs.
steps: Contact the PFA that currently manages one of your RSA PINs, state that you have multiple RSA registrations, and present every RSA PIN or welcome letter you can identify.
Ask the PFA to identify which RSA PIN should remain active, confirm which other PINs must be reconciled, and check whether the valid RSA has completed Data Recapture.
Complete Data Recapture for the RSA PIN the PFA confirms should remain valid if that account has not yet been recaptured.

Submit the duplicate PIN information and supporting evidence through the PFA/PenCom reconciliation route; FGN Treasury-funded MDA employees and retirees follow the specific reconciliation rules issued for that group.
Wait for the PFA or PenCom confirmation that the duplicate registrations have been reconciled before giving employers the final valid RSA details.
notes: PenCom warns that multiple RSAs can cause incorrect remittances and delay access to retirement benefits.
PenCom's FAQ says contributions in multiple RSAs can be merged, subject to the reconciliation rules that apply to the contributor's employment category.
Changing from one PFA to another is a separate RSA Transfer System process and should not create a second RSA.
